title: Rabbi Avdimos
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A Palestinian Amora of the third and fourth generations. Hyman mentions him only in Ketubot 11:2: after his death the heirs told his widow that Rabbi Abba bar Kohen wished to marry her, so that she would claim her ketubah and they would then be released from providing her maintenance. They came to Rabbi Yose, who restored her maintenance. He is also mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 1:14; see there.

notes.text: The third/fourth-generation placement is Hyman’s. Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 11:2 confirms the widow, marriage pretext, ketubah claim and Rabbi Yose’s restoration of maintenance. Hyman’s additional Bereshit Rabbah citation is retained despite his preceding “only” formulation.
The consulted Ketubot 11:2 has the widow’s case and Rabbi Yose’s restoration of maintenance. It does not independently establish the proposed generation assignment.
